Ghost Butler (Korean: 집사 유령, jipssa yuryong) is an Epic Pet that was released alongside his owner, Blackberry Cookie, during the Secrets of the Lost City update. He creates Power Jellies in a certain looping order, which can help progression through a number of boosts.

Story

This ghost is the spirit of a faithful butler that oversaw the management of an ancient mansion.

His loyalty to this household was so engrained into his very being that even after he passed away, his soul continues to haunt the mansion while going about his incredibly tight schedule with the ease of a pro.

Does he ever take a break? Nobody knows.

Skill

Ghost Butler's Skill
Creates Power Jellies on top of Basic Jellies in a set sequence at certain intervals. Earn additional points for all Jellies, Bear Jellies, and Colorful Star Jellies while in Blast Mode. Level Up for more Energy restored from Potions created by the Pet and even more points for the above Jellies while in Blast Mode.
Level Skill
1 Creates Power Jellies every 8 sec in a set sequence
+140 pts for all Jellies in Blast Mode
+140 pts for all Bear Jellies
+210 pts for Colorful Star Jellies
+4 Energy recovered from Small Potions
15 Creates Power Jellies every 8 sec in a set sequence
+1,400 pts for all Jellies in Blast Mode
+1,400 pts for all Bear Jellies
+2,100 pts for Colorful Star Jellies
+10 Energy recovered from Small Potions

Gameplay Notes

  1. The Power Jellies created by Ghost Butler are arranged in the following order:
    • Potion → Colorful Star Jelly Party → Potion → Yellow Bear Jelly Party → Potion+Blast Jelly → Colorful Star Jelly Party → Giant+Blast Jelly → Colorful Star Jelly Party → Potion → Blast Jelly → Pink Bear Jelly Party → Colorful Star Jelly Party → Potion+Blast Jelly → Giant+Blast Jelly → Potion → Colorful Star Jelly Party → Frozen Bear Jelly Party → Colorful Star Jelly Party → Blast Jelly → Yellow Bear Jelly Party → Giant+Blast Jelly → Colorful Star Jelly Party → Potion → Pink Bear Jelly Party → Blast Jelly → Colorful Star Jelly Party → Potion+Blast Jelly → Frozen Bear Jelly Party → Colorful Star Jelly Party → Giant+Blast Jelly → Colorful Star Jelly Party → Yellow Bear Jelly Party → Potion → Blast Jelly

Changelog

  • Our Special Pie Party! - November 14, 2024
    • Obtained a Costume,  Full Moon Party Planner.
    • Increased Skill cooldown by 2.2 sec.
    • Changed the type and order of Power Jellies created.
    • Added point increase for all Jellies collected during Blast Mode.
    • Added point increase for all Bear Jellies.
    • Added a Colorful Star Jelly Party to Ghost Butler's Power Jellies lineup. (Unmentioned in patch notes)
    • Added point increase for Colorful Star Jellies.
  • Spooky School Experience - July 28, 2022
    • Decreased cooldown time.
    • Added Pink Bear Jelly Parties and Recovery Blast Potions have been added to the list of items generated.
    • Combi Bonus with Blackberry Cookie: Increased points for Blackberry Jellies.
  • Dazzling Year's End Party - December 8, 2020
    • Cooldown now locked to remain constant.
    • Changed to provide more potent Potions with each Level.
  • Spooky Spider Mansion - September 8, 2020
    • Decreased cooldown.
    • Changed types and order of created Power Jellies.
    • Combi Bonus with Blackberry Cookie: Increased points for Blackberry Jellies from +66,000 to +185,000.
  • Sands of Yogurca - July 30, 2019
    • Combi Bonus with Blackberry Cookie: Changed from "Energy drains 13% slower" to "+66,000 points for Blackberry Jellies."

Trivia

  • If Ghost Butler's description is to be believed, he was originally a normal butler who passed away and became a Pet.
